title: Stocks I'm looking at this earnings week
author: SnowSilent7695
selftext:
I lookout for stocks announcing earnings every week, asking Claude, "Please list all upcoming earnings announcements this week, along with their predictions. Please rank the ones with the biggest upside, and also factor their recent earnings performance (whether the exceeded expectations, by how much, etc.), management's commentary, key themes, and whether those are poised to continue."

The one I'm looking out for the most is AMAT--has beaten earnings for the last 8 consecutive quarters, and it had a blowout quarter last time, with management also raising guidance. Given the continued strong AI demand/spending, I don't see any of the catalysts changing suddenly, making it poised for a rebound, after being down \~8% this past month. 

  
Here are the other ones that were listed:

|Ticker|Rationale|Expected 1-Day Move|Earnings Beat Past 8 Quarter|
|:-|:-|:-|:-|
|**ENS**|Beaten earnings for 8 consecutive quarters. Down \~17% over three months, so a positive report makes it poised for a rebound.|**+2.91%**|**8/8**|
|**KTB**|Similar to ENS. Personally, not really bullish on the consumer sector right now, but am considering KTB, since it's done well this past year and is good portfolio diversifier.|**+1.90%**|**8/8**|
|**WWW**|Strong technical setup and beaten earnings 8 straight quarters.|**+2.60%**|**8/8**|
|**CSCO**|Stock has done really well this year. And the outlook for AI infrastructure hasn't weakened. They'll have to provide exceptional financials and a very strong outlook to keep the momentum.|**+2.42%**|**8/8**|
